analyst.summary: JSW Energy posted a strong FY26 on paper (EBITDA +81%, PAT +39%) and has a credible long-dated growth story (13.45GW to a 30GW-by-2030 target, with hydro storage and thermal assets added along the way), but a large chunk of that growth came from buying existing plants (KSK Mahanadi, O2 Power) rather than organic expansion, and the balance sheet has gotten notably more leveraged funding it (net debt roughly 6x EBITDA), forcing the company to raise fresh equity this year. At ~42-50x trailing earnings against an ~8% return on equity, the stock is priced for flawless execution of that growth plan, with little room for a leverage, merchant-price, or receivables surprise -- we rate it a Sell.
